authors.bio: Thomas F. Klimek received the B.S. in Electrical Engineering from the University of Detroit, and the M.S. from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. After serving as Technical Operations Officer at the Supersonic Wind Tunnel, Aberdeen Proving Grounds, he joined the Bendix Corporation's Aerospace Systems Division where he filled various positions in Systems Engineering, Analysis and Preliminary Design. As Coordinator of Scientific Computing, he was responsible for all engineering applications of the digital and analog computers. In 1976, he founded Computer Creations, Inc., where he is president. Mr. Klimek is a member of IEEE, SMPTE, and ACM, and hold patents in missile guidance and signal processing.
authors.name: Thomas F. Klimek

authors.bio: Herman E. Towles graduated from Memphis State University in 1971 with both the B.S. and M.S. degrees in Electrical Engineering. As a member of the founding team at Computer Creations, Inc., Mr. Towles' career as Vice President of Computer Systems involves him in all aspects of digital animation research and production. He is a member of IEEE and ACM.
